property_summary: For any recipient, getFirstWithdrawalBonus always completes successfully; the mutant (which never sets the lock) lets the recipient's reentrant getFirstWithdrawalBonus call succeed during it, the recipient then reverts, and the outer call reverts too, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Delete `_locked = true;` so the guard no longer sets the lock, allowing reentrant calls to withdrawReward and changing rewardsForA afterwards.
